ownRead.body:
## Start with the definition authority

- [00 — Locked core](/documents/locked-core/): normative definitions, structural recursion and the explicit open-extension boundaries.
- [05 — Research and change control](/changes/): classification of research and the proof gate for a proposed definition change.

- [Current source changelog](/changes/source-history/): adopted source repairs and its evidence-only update.

## Then read the implementations and tests

- [02 — Scientific framework](/framework/): non-normative propositions, source-reported support and research programme.
- [03 — Candidate mathematics](/math/): model assumptions, equations, proposed experiments and retained addenda.
- [04 — Research status](/research-status/), [06/07/08 evidence](/evidence/) and [open questions](/open-problems/): what is reported and what remains to be demonstrated.

Each reading retains its supplied edition and source context. The source body is rendered from the original document rather than maintained as a separate website copy. [Start](/start/) offers a simpler reading path.

## Current and historical work

The v0.1a/v0.1b addenda retained inside the current mathematical document belong to that supplied edition. Its candidate calculations and experiments are proposals, not results executed by this website. The separate historical cavity/response-reduction calculations are not selected for this edition’s website; they are not presented as evidence for the current programme.

checks.terminology: The library preserves locked core as normative authority, framework as non-normative, mathematics as candidate models/tests and proof/status/evidence as distinct readings.
checks.meaning: Source changelog and research/change control remain separately linked; website presentation history does not advance the research edition.
checks.assumptions: Candidate mathematics and experiments are explicitly proposals, and retained v0.1a/v0.1b addenda belong to the supplied current edition; no new model premise is added.
checks.hypotheses: Open questions and evidence readings are discoverable without turning source-reported evidence into proof of universal recursion or force unification.
checks.evidenceDescriptions: Separate historical cavity/response calculations remain not selected, with no website execution claim. No historical body or administrative evidence is in the actual ZIP.
checks.openQuestions: Private draft states, stale fidelity badges, unpublished dates and citation/rights gates remain visible. Empty Historical Sources group accurately reports no separately selected historical body.
checks.attribution: Grouped entries expose audience, edition, revision and update/publication status from the shared manifest. Original links retain source hashes and distinguish explanatory exports from exact-byte downloads.
checks.sourceMappings: Compared DOC-CORE/CONTROL/FRAMEWORK/MATH sidecars and original 00/05/02/03 headings/status, current CHANGELOG, actual both-base library rows and companion links. Library adds navigation, not separately maintained science.
